lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dominant horizontal row of large, high-luminance circular blobs is centered on the mid-lateral flank. Superior to this row, multiple staggered rows of smaller, higher-density spots are arranged in a triangular grid-like fashion. The inter-blob distance increases toward the posterior-ventral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, particularly in the mid-anterior section, intersecting with the horizontal spot rows to create distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, fusiform silhouettes (commensal Echeneidae) are visible in the lower right quadrant of the frame, swimming in close proximity to the ventral-posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
